key_material.normalised_safe_text: NFKC plus whitespace-normalised SanitizedModelInput.redacted_text; no raw value is persisted

invalidation_cases.change: model revision, prompt, schema, or policy version
cached candidate mutation, invalid schema/source, detectable PII, or incompatible metadata
invalidation_cases.expected: not cached or rejected as CACHE_CORRUPT; never returned
UNSAFE_CACHE_INPUT; no cache read or write

runtime_rules.normal_path: always calls the upstream model before considering any cache
runtime_rules.live_mode: LIVE forces cache_enabled=false and bypasses all cache reads/writes
runtime_rules.cached_payload: CandidateExtraction only; no AnalyzeCaseResponse, DecisionResult, accountability state, ledger snapshot, deadline, human edit, or event status
runtime_rules.fallback_metadata: preserves the origin run_id and sets ModelMetadata.cached_result=true
runtime_rules.governance_requirement: a redacted current request_id/origin run_id relation must be recorded before serving fallback

evidence_scope: Implementation-test evidence only; not an independent verification or integration receipt.
